what: a side file a tool writes itself (scenes/multicam/silence --edl, caption's SRT and ASS, metadata's --chapters-out/--description-out, render's project and pack, verify/report's --report) was written with a plain open()/Path.write_text() after its output check, so a file another process created or edited at that path during the run was overwritten without --overwrite, and an interrupted write left a truncated sidecar
escaped: the replace-time recheck (#470) covered ffmpeg's own outputs and only two files a tool replaces itself (silence.py --timemap, export.py's fill/key); the side-file guards recorded the check but the plain write never compared it again, and no test wrote a sidecar after its check
mechanism: runner.write_sidecar stages a caller-named side file as a hidden sibling temp and puts it in place through replace_checked(), under the path's output lock after refuse_changed_output(); a target the check recorded absent is installed with os.link() so a file created in the gap is refused instead of replaced (under --overwrite, consent to replace that path, it is replaced after being moved aside when a pair fails, so the other file is put back), an existing target keeps its permission bits and its group (the staged file takes the target's group before its chmod, and a writer that may not set it is refused with output_group_not_settable rather than replacing the file with one in another group), an absent target whose os.link() install fails on a filesystem without hard links is created exclusively and filled from the staged file, so a file that appeared is refused there too, and the replaced target's access ACL is copied onto the staged file (a writer that cannot copy it is refused with output_acl_not_preserved), and the identity recorded (also in batch.py's report) is the staged file's, captured before the install, or the copied inode's when the name had to be created; scenes, multicam, metadata, silence, caption, asr, _ass_overlay, render, report and verify call it instead of a plain open(); test_a_side_file_written_after_its_check_is_refused_and_one_left_alone_is_written, test_a_side_file_created_between_the_comparison_and_the_install_is_refused, test_an_absent_side_file_that_appears_before_the_install_is_replaced_under_overwrite, test_an_overwrite_pair_puts_back_a_file_that_appeared_at_a_checked_absent_target, test_the_identity_recorded_for_a_side_file_is_the_staged_file_not_a_foreign_one, test_a_side_file_keeps_the_mode_of_the_file_it_replaces, test_a_side_file_keeps_the_group_of_the_file_it_replaces and test_every_side_file_a_tool_writes_itself_goes_through_the_rechecked_helper pin the refusal, the install window, the record, the mode, the group and the source sweep
size_reason: the fix measures 108 net Python lines in scripts/ against the merge base (168 added, 60 removed), over fix_max_net_lines (50): the shared writer replaces ten plain open()/write_text() calls across thirteen files and holds the staging, mode, group, identity and install-window logic itself, and trimming it would keep a per-caller write path this change exists to remove. The second review pass adds no net Python line: --overwrite now skips the link install, so a target absent at the check still gives consent to replace whatever is there. The third review pass adds no net Python line either: the paired install keeps the backup for that file under --overwrite, so a failed pair puts back what was there. The fourth review pass adds the group keep and its refusal in runner.py, the one reason in _contract.ERROR_REASONS and the doc lines that state it; the counted tree is 35116 lines against the raised ceiling. The fifth review pass adds the exclusive-create install for a filesystem without hard links, the access-ACL copy and its refusal, and the tests and doc lines for both; the fix measures 231 net Python lines against the merge base (295 added, 64 removed), over fix_max_net_lines (50) because this pass alone adds 123: the no-clobber fallback, the ACL copy, and the two refusals are the guarantees the review asked for, and trimming them would leave the old replace or lose named users' permissions.
